column2: Kal ki meeting mein humein project ka timeline discuss karna hai, toh please slides ready rakhna.
Yaar maine code push kar diya hai, bas ek baar PR review kar lo aur phir merge kar dena.
Mujhe lagta hai ki humein database ko migrate karna chahiye, current setup bahut slow hai.
Client ne bola hai ki deadline Friday tak extend ho sakti hai, but confirm karna padega.
